thread:
linh: Onboarding q4a-quant8 to staging — noticing sample churn when tokenizers differ across langs. Some prompts get duplicated after token normalization. Anyone seen this? (cc @maya @andre)

maya: saw something similar with m2v/tokenizer change last month. Is this tied to normalization (NFKC) or to truncation by subtokens?

linh: looks like both. Example:
```
zh prompt: "你好，帮我写个摘要"
tokenized (old): [567, 89, 345]
tokenized (new): [567, 89, 345, 0]
```
Not exact ids but shows stray pad/eos getting appended which breaks fingerprint equality.

andre: can you paste the raw input pipeline snippet? Also what's the sampler config — reservoir or stratified?

linh: sampler = reservoir_v2; dedupe uses utf8-normalized string fingerprinting then simhash. suspect tokenization adds tiny variance so fingerprinting misses duplicates.

maya: quick idea: run tokenizer -> unicode normalize -> reconstruct string then fingerprint. Or use token-id-based dedupe hash to catch tokenizer drift.

sam: labeler note — if we change dedupe, expect overlap with existing golden. Need a relabel window and communicate to labelers. :warning:

linh: agree. propose: small experiment on 2k prompts (en/zh/ja/ko) comparing token-id dedupe vs string-fingerprint. collect collisions and surface for manual check.

andre: assignable? I can run the sampling job and produce metrics. Need the input spec.

linh: dataset spec: languages=["en","zh","ja","ko"], max_len=1024, seed_bank=stable-2026-03, fingerprint_methods=["utf8_norm", "token_ids"], comparator=simhash-64

maya: add columns tokenizer_version and quant_version. Also capture model-run outputs for top-3 models to see downstream quality delta.

labeler-bot: Reminder: label queue schema change required if we add tokenizer_version fields. @ops please approve.

ops: Approved for staging only. Will patch queue schema by EOD.

andre: started job 2135680000, ETA ~25m

linh: thx. Once we have collisions, we'll pick 200 collision pairs for human review. Labeler team — can you allocate 1 day? @sam

sam: can do 200 in 6 hours, will prioritize.

maya: also let's log tokenization diffs in the prompt pipeline; add a small flag to emit before/after normalized string for each sample.

linh: good call.

andre: job finished. initial numbers: total=2000, token_id_dedupe_removed=420, utf8_norm_removed=375, overlap=312, unique_by_token_but_same_by_string=108

maya: interesting — token_id dedupe removed more; the 108 where token_ids differ but strings same look like normalization-caused spreads (e.g., full-width vs half-width, mixture of composed/decomposed).

sam: scheduling review session 11AM tomorrow. will bring examples and annotate likely false-positives.

linh: plan after review: if token_id de-dupe reduces noise without hurting recall, we'll switch sampling de-dupe to token-based for multilingual routes and keep string-based as fallback for legacy. Rollout via canary in staging first.

andre: I'll surface perf delta and cost impact in the job report.

labeler-bot: Label queue schema updated in staging at 2135681800.

ops: deployed tokenizer diff logging and queue patch to staging at 2135682000 :rocket:

linh: thanks all. I'll post artifacts (job output + 200 pairs) in the thread shortly.

maya: thanks, nice quick turnaround :thumbsup:
